facts.text: The party must bring metal from the Dwarven mine north of Brandonsford back to Warwick the smith. In exchange he lent them his mithril shirt, and he keeps Sir Phidipaldi's lyre to use every night while they are gone.

Wayman Tisdale wears Warwick's mithril chain shirt, which once belonged to Warwick's grandfather, over his leather armor. It greatly improves his protection and halves damage from magic weapons and spells. It is on loan from Warwick, who holds the party's plate armor as collateral.
A natural-looking cave-in seals the Dwarven mine entrance and blocks getting metal for Warwick. It can be dug through, and Dunk has already shoulder-charged partway in.
Is there still metal to be had inside the Dwarven mine, now that the cabin is burnt, the mine is caved in and Grimny is dead?
